title: agent-bureau: the console's claude_usage_reading table holds 0 rows — carry each run's usage reading into it
body:
The console's `claude_usage_reading` table holds 0 rows. Nothing carries a run's usage reading into it: the emit step writes the reading into the run's own log and stops there, so the Accounts panel has nothing to draw.

The fix is the S3 route: the emit step uploads each reading to the agent-log bucket, and a console consumer reads the bucket and inserts one row per reading into `claude_usage_reading`.

That fix never merged — its pull request was closed unmerged, and the table is still empty.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The emit step uploads each usage reading to the agent-log bucket.
- [ ] A console consumer reads the bucket and inserts one row per reading into `claude_usage_reading`.
- [ ] After one run, `claude_usage_reading` holds at least one row.
evidence: DRE-4587 is Done: the console's usage probe now inserts one row per window into claude_usage_reading each time it reads an account.

comments.body: The S3 route PR was closed unmerged. Is the Accounts panel still empty?
